_comment: Labelled evaluation set for knowledge-base retrieval. Each in_kb question is answered by exactly one document in knowledge_base/; 'source' is that file. out_of_kb questions are plausible but NOT answered by any document (used to check the agent retrieves/answers only what it knows).
